achievements.name: The Meaning of Prosperity
achievements.description: Help Carmina get back to her mother in Prosperity. Host only.

achievements.name: Prospering
achievements.description: Upgrade and secure Prosperity. Host only.

achievements.name: Return to Eden
achievements.description: Bring the Father back to New Eden. Host only.

achievements.name: Problem Solver
achievements.description: Solve the biggest problem in Hope County by defeating the Twins. Host only.

achievements.name: The End of Eden
achievements.description: Decide the fate of the Father. Host only.

achievements.name: A Graceful Return
achievements.description: Recover Grace's prototype gun and welcome her back to Prosperity for good. Host only.

achievements.name: Coming Up With the Goods
achievements.description: Return Selene's valuable stash. Host only.

achievements.name: Wiki-Bean-ia in Business
achievements.description: Help Bean get back his business plan so he can set up his intel network in Prosperity. Host only.

achievements.name: The Ryeunion
achievements.description: Reunite Nick Rye with Carmina and Kim. Host only.

achievements.name: Expeditious Retreat
achievements.description: Complete your first Expedition to force the Highwaymen out of a stronghold.

achievements.name: Honorary Scout
achievements.description: Gather intel 10 times by talking to Wiki-Bean-ia scouts. Host only.

achievements.name: Yoink
achievements.description: Loot a Highwaymen Supply Drop. Be careful, it won't be unguarded!

achievements.name: Forager
achievements.description: Gather 15 plants growing in Hope County. It's the closest thing to a pharmacy we have nowadays.

achievements.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
achievements.description: Scavenge an Outpost. You can always reclaim it. Host only.

achievements.name: Home is Where the Part Is
achievements.description: Upgrade Prosperity's infrastructure for the first time by investing in the right parts. Host only.

achievements.name: Sidecar Sidekick
achievements.description: Drive with Timber for a total of 5 minutes. Just don't take him to the vet.

achievements.name: White Gold
achievements.description: Commandeer an Ethanol tanker and bring it back to one of your outposts.

achievements.name: Finders Keepers
achievements.description: Complete 3 Treasure Hunt missions. Host only.

achievements.name: Safekeeping
achievements.description: Picklock 5 safes. With no more banks, it's the closest thing you'll get to experiencing a heist.

achievements.name: Closed for Applications
achievements.description: Recruit all Guns For Hire. Host only.

achievements.name: How's it Look, Doc?
achievements.description: Craft 10 Medkits. They'll definitely come in handy.

achievements.name: Kill or Be Killed
achievements.description: Kill a Monstrous animal. It'd do the same to you given half the chance.

achievements.name: Paladin’s Secret
achievements.description: Find Sam Fisher’s outfit in the Government Plane Wreck expedition

achievements.name: Before
achievements.description: Find all the Dear Photograph locations and see Hope County as it used to be. Host only.

achievements.name: Audiophile
achievements.description: Rediscover some sweet tunes for the new world. Find all hidden MP3 players. Host only.

achievements.name: My Little Fortress
achievements.description: Make Prosperity better than ever! Build all Infrastructure upgrades available. Host only.

achievements.name: Master Skinner
achievements.description: Collect at least one skin from every type of animal in Hope County. Not creepy at all.

achievements.name: Hit the Road
achievements.description: Complete 7 unique Expeditions on the Rank III difficulty.

achievements.name: Pure Ninja
achievements.description: Liberate a Rank III Outpost while staying undetected.

achievements.name: All Your Bases
achievements.description: Liberate all Outposts at least once on Rank III.

achievements.name: Weaponsmith
achievements.description: Craft 3 weapons. They don't need to look good, they just need to get the job done!

achievements.name: You're a Catch
achievements.description: Successfully catch one of every type of fish in Hope County. Get those omega-3s.

achievements.name: Save Your Bacon
achievements.description: Recruit Horatio. Don't mind his temper, he can be pig-headed sometimes. Host only.

achievements.name: Poof!
achievements.description: Use 3 smoke grenades.

achievements.name: It's Super Effective!
achievements.description: Headshot an Enforcer with Piercing Ammo.

achievements.name: Have Buddy, Will Travel
achievements.description: Complete 3 Expeditions with a co-op partner.

achievements.name: Bring a Knife to a Gun Fight
achievements.description: Kill 25 enemies using any type of takedown. Put that railroad spike to good use!

achievements.name: Captain's Courageous
achievements.description: Kill your first Enforcer. I'm sure this will send the Highwaymen a good message.

achievements.name: Good Job, Cap
achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies by throwing a shield at them.

achievements.name: Stack 'em Up
achievements.description: Purchase the 5th tier of a stackable perk. You can never have enough.

achievements.name: Fly, You Fools!
achievements.description: No wings means less drag, right? Take a short flight in the wingless plane.

achievements.name: Buzzkill
achievements.description: Kill 10 brawlers with any saw launcher. They never saw it coming.

achievements.name: Legend Has It
achievements.description: Craft your first Legendary Weapon or Vehicle and start a legend of your own.

achievements.name: Tip o' the Hat
achievements.description: Knock an enemy's helmet off with a charged melee attack.

achievements.name: Anger Management
achievements.description: Eliminate 10 enemies within a single activation of Wrath.

achievements.name: Hey Father, Watch This
achievements.description: Perform an Aerial Takedown after using Leap of Faith.

achievements.name: Perk-olate
achievements.description: Unlock the first level for all Perks.

achievements.name: Archery Expert
achievements.description: Kill an enemy more than 100m away with a basic arrow.

achievements.name: Get to the Point
achievements.description: Finish off an Enforcer with a bayonet.

achievements.name: Springboard
achievements.description: Survive a 30m fall using only Leap of Faith to nullify the impact.
